notes.title: New Small Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I made a few changes to the game, hopefully you guys can check it out as soon as possible.

[h2]PARTICLES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added smoke particles to grill when cooking meat
[*] Added white explosion particles when completing the right order
[*] Added drink splash particles when pouring soda
[/list]

[h2]ART[/h2]
[list]
[*] Revamped outlines to be black instead of dark blue
[*] Slightly changed drink machine to look more clean
[*] Changed NPC outlines to black and fixed Janet's jacket with the lone pixel
[*] New animation for the trash can
[/list]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*] New indicators to make the drink machine more intuitive
[*] Players are told why they get their orders wrong
[*] Added Steam Rich Presence, currently only for The Grid (2v2)
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed The Grid's lobby to function correctly after leaving, but there still may be some bugs present
[*] Minor changes to how Steam hosts the lobby in The Grid
[/list]

notes.title: New Multiplayer Update! (version 0.2.1)
notes.notes:
[h3]Feel Free to Join our Discord![/h3]
Here's the link: https://discord.gg/xpnX6RvUk3

Hey everyone! I am so excited to share with you all the newest update that I recently developed, known as the grid! It's a new 2v2 co-op game mode that will be available to everyone. Hopefully you all can try it out soon with your friends!

[h1]THE GRID[/h1]
[i]What is The Grid?[/i]
[list]
[*] The grid is a new multiplayer game mode where there are two teams (red & blue)
[*] Both teams are trying to finish the grid of orders the fastest
[*] You need to complete all 25 orders with your teammate to win
[*] All orders on the grid require a drink (remember to serve drinks!)
[/list]
[i]How do I play The Grid?[/i]
[list]
[*] Right now, you only need to find 3 other friends to join your lobby
[*] You can easily host one in the main menu by clicking on "The Grid" in the "Play" page
[*] The first two people who join your lobby are automatically in Team Red, and the other two are Team Blue. (Most likely will be changed so players can choose their own teams)
[/list]
[i]Do I need friends to play?[/i]
[list]
[*] As of now, lobbies can only be joined through Steam from your friends list.
[*] You need four people total (including yourself) to play
[*] There is no currently no random matchmaking, but this feature may be added in future updates
[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you could spawn two cups using the red drink button
[*] Fixed bug where clicking the red cup slot would not work
[*] Fixed bug where the "Saucy" achievement would not be given to players (now you will also get the achievement if you already unlocked it previously)
[*] Fixed bug where spamming the grill would produce more meats than usual
[*] Fixed bug where you can cook invisible meats
[*] Fixed bug where the transition would appear from the right side instead of the left
[*] Fixed bug where you could click the order paper after you clicked the bell
[*] Fixed bug where you couldn't open the paper the next day
[*] Fixed bug where new food order notification would not show up
[*] Fixed bug where new drink notification would not show up
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a settings page to adjust music & sound effects volume
[*] Reformatted main menu
[*] Pressing "New Game" will warn you if you already had a save file
[*] Changed certain sound effects for some buttons
[*] Revamped UI so that buttons may be more responsive
[/list]

[h1]NEW EPICURE TRAILER[/h1]
I made a new trailer for Epicure! I'll update this on the Steam store page shortly, and hopefully this video will better represent the newest version of the game.

[previewyoutube=GzQyk8itsb0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Epicure Discord bug Fixed
notes.notes: Hey everyone, the annoying bug where Epicure only works if Discord is running has been finally crushed. Sorry it took a few days to fix, but you can all play normally again. Feel free to let me know if there are any other glitches or bugs that affect gameplay :)

notes.title: Epicure Major Bug – Will be Fixed Soon
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, devOrange here. Really apologize for the inconvenience.

[h3][b]For now, Epicure will be only playable if you have Discord running.[/b][/h3]

Epicure won't be running if you do not have Discord installed, and I am getting it fixed as soon as possible. I reached out to the Discord team and I will be updating the game shortly. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Huge Epicure Update – 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! I apologize for the very long wait, but the update is finally here! Really excited to share these changes with all of you.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where a cooked patty would be replaced by a raw one
[*] Fixed bug where money would not be saved
[*] Fixed bug where loading a save game would not save anything
[*] Fixed duplicate sound for placing buns
[*] Fixed bug where two cups could be instantiated in the scene
[*] Fixed bug where sauces would disappear after loading the game, even after unlocking it
[/list]

[h1][b]NEW CHARACTER[/b][/h1]
[list]
[h3]Added a new NPC: Janet! (appears every 5th day)[/h3]
[*] She’s hosting a party and needs burgers
[*] Will pay 2x the amount
[*] However, wrong orders will deduct 2x the amount as well
[/list]

[h1][b]OVERALL UI CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added fill to font (looks way better now)
[*] Updated main menu buttons to be consistent with font
[*] Updated main menu background
[*] New sound effects to the shop screen
[/list]

[h1][b]SHOP CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Entirely revamped shop
[*] New shop page menu with 3 main sub-pages
[/list]
[h3]1. Upgrade Ingredients[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upgrade the basic ingredients to earn more coins
[*] $2000: Lettuce, Tomatoes, Cheese
[*] $3000: Meat (since it gives more coins)
[*] White star icon shows in the kitchen when you upgrade it
[/list]
[h3]2. Unlock Ingredients[/h3]
[list]
[*] Still have your classic Ketchup & Mustard
[*] Balance Change, price from $3000 to $4000
[*] More unlockable ingredients will be available in future updates
[/list]
[h3]3. Colors[/h3]
[list]
[*] Change the color of the kitchen’s tabletop!
[*] Preview the changes in the shop as well
[*] $1000: Red, Orange, Yellow
[*] $1500: Green, Blue, Purple
[*] $2000: Pink, Black
[/list]

[h1][b]OTHER IMPORTANT CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New Song!
[*] Reformatted Results Page
[*] New icons for each result
[*] You can skip the dialogue now
[*] Sam (the critic) appears every 5th day from day 3 (3, 8, 13…)
[*] Janet (new character) appears every 5th day (5, 10, 15…)
[*] [h3]Discord Rich Presence now Available![/h3]
[/list]

That's it for now, feel free to leave any suggestions, comments, or bug reports in the community tab! I will be reading them more often and I will continue to work on Epicure throughout this winter. See you all soon in the next update :)
